title: The Rook
summary: Straight lines, any distance — meet the powerful rook.

steps.text: The ROOK moves in straight lines — up, down, left, or right — as far as it wants, but it can't jump over other pieces.

steps.prompt: Move the rook straight up to d8.
steps.successText: Zoom! You moved the rook the whole way up the file!
steps.retryText: Not quite — remember, the rook only moves in straight lines. Try again!

steps.prompt: Now slide the rook all the way to the right, to h4.
steps.successText: You moved along the rank this time!
steps.retryText: Try again — slide sideways along the rank to h4.

steps.prompt: There's a pawn in the way on d7! Capture it by moving your rook there.
steps.successText: Great capture! You gobbled up the pawn.
steps.retryText: The pawn is on d7 — slide your rook up the file to capture it.

steps.prompt: Slide the rook along the rank and capture the pawn on e4.
steps.successText: Nice! Rooks are just as strong along ranks.
steps.retryText: The pawn is on e4 — slide sideways to capture it.

steps.text: Rooks are strong pieces — they control whole ranks and files! Next, let's learn the bishop.
